deliverables: Allocate capital to builders advancing Cardano Vision 2030 KPIs including monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL
Require funded projects to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions
Continue KPI dashboard development toward live on-chain Cardano data tracking
Use an independent multisig governed by assigned dRep DAO members for milestone-based disbursement
Return unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds to the Cardano Treasury
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO / independent council administrator composed of dRep DAO members prior to milestone-based disbursement
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to continue and expand the Cardano Builder DAO as a smart contract-governed, KPI-driven funding mechanism for Cardano builders.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is proposed as an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed funding mechanism to support projects advancing Cardano Vision 2030 through measurable KPIs.
The proposal says funded projects will be required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
The DAO built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, with Version 2 moving toward KPI tracking tied directly to live on-chain Cardano data.
The Cardano Builder DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
Round 1 funded 20 companies, had 38 voting members and 27 requesting members, distributed 5,541,335 ADA, and achieved 83% participation in governance actions.
Round 2 funded 14 companies, added 18 new members, and achieved 88% participation among members after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.

The DAO says it created and amended governing documents, elected a board, added third-party assurance, implemented merit-based proposal review, and executed treasury withdrawals on-chain with transparency.

The proposal states that official Cardano developer documentation describes the CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions.

An independent council including Cardano Yoda, Marco Grendel Moshi, and one additional unaffiliated active dRep is proposed to receive the withdrawal, hold funds, oversee disbursement, and validate milestones before the DAO receives funds.
The CB DAO returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the Cardano Treasury after its first two governance rounds, with an Adastat transaction link provided.

summary: The document requests 20,000,000 ADA for a KPI-driven builder funding DAO, emphasizes prior DAO funding rounds and governance participation, proposes independent multisig milestone administration, and cites external references for retrospectives, governance portals, budget milestones, and a prior treasury repayment.
